info.title: Cortex AI Backend API
info.description:
Cortex AI — RAG-powered document chat with team workspaces, Stripe billing and admin analytics. Built for the ZYROO Cortex AI Backend Development Internship (Weeks 1-8) in Python + FastAPI.

**Auth:** register / log in to get a JWT, then send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every protected endpoint.

post.description: Create a user (bcrypt-hashed password) and return a JWT.

post.summary: Log in and get a JWT
post.description: Verify credentials and return a JWT. Generic error on failure.

get.description: Protected route — returns the user behind the JWT.
Documents I own, plus documents in workspaces I belong to.

schema.title: Response List Documents Api Documents Get

post.description:
Multipart upload: validate, extract, chunk (~500 tokens, ~50 overlap),
embed each chunk, mark the document ready. Usage counts against the
workspace's shared Team quota when workspace_id is given, otherwise
against the user's own plan quota.

delete.summary: Delete a document and its chunks

post.description:
Embed the query and return the top-k most similar chunks, scoped to
one document, one workspace, or all documents I can access.

schema.title: Response List Sessions Api Chat Sessions Get

post.description:
Retrieve relevant chunks, call Groq (or the grounded fallback), and
return the assistant reply with its cited sources.

schema.title: Response Get Messages Api Chat Sessions  Session Id  Messages Get

post.description:
Same RAG flow as POST .../messages, streamed back token-by-token
(word-by-word here) as Server-Sent Events.

get.description: Free / Pro / Team with prices and limits.

schema.title: Response List Plans Api Billing Plans Get

post.summary: Create a Stripe Checkout session to upgrade
Cancel my subscription at period end

schema.title: Response List Workspaces Api Workspaces Get

post.description: The creator is automatically added as owner. Requires a Team plan.
Only the workspace owner can invite. Prevents duplicate memberships.

delete.description:
Only the owner can remove members, and the owner cannot remove
themselves.

schema.title: Response List Workspace Documents Api Workspaces  Workspace Id  Documents Get
Response List Workspace Sessions Api Workspaces  Workspace Id  Chat Sessions Get

get.description:
All registered users (never password hashes) with plan, usage,
suspension status and creation date. Paginated with skip/limit.

schema.title: Response List Users Api Admin Users Get
Response List All Workspaces Api Admin Workspaces Get

patch.description:
Set is_suspended (or toggle it when omitted). Suspended users are
immediately rejected with 403 by get_current_user everywhere.

get.description:
Last-30-days summary: daily active users, messages per day, plan
distribution, subscription counts, and LLM token usage / cost.

Reset usage counters for users whose billing period has ended.

Protected by CRON_SECRET. Vercel Cron sends it automatically when
the secret is set in the Vercel dashboard.
